mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ledger_entry (account_id, bucket, entry_type, amount, value_after, biz_type, biz_id, remark) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{bucket}, #{entryType}, #{amount}, #{valueAfter}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT biz_id AS k, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM ledger_entry WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND entry_type = #{entryType} AND bucket = #{bucket} GROUP BY biz_id
